paragraphs: Rabbi Abba bar Bizna — [Bava Kamma, chapter 5, halakha 7 (Jerusalem Talmud)](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Bava_Kamma.5.7.3).[^1]
Rabbi Bibi bar Bizna — see his entry.
Rabbi Yitzhak bar Bizna — [Shekalim, chapter 8, halakha 2 (Jerusalem Talmud)](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Shekalim.8.2.4).

notes.text: [Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 5:7](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Bava_Kamma.5.7.3) reads Ba bar Bizna; Guggenheimer translates the name as Abba bar Bizna and proposes “bar Bina” in his note. [Shekalim 8:2](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Shekalim.8.2.4) reads Yitzhak bar Bisna (בסנא) in the name of Shmuel. [Heilprin’s list under Bizna](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=701&lang=en) includes several of the same patronymics. A shared patronymic leaves the family relationships open.
